label: Active
description: Checks in often and always keeps every hero questing on the best-value offer available.

label: Casual
description: Checks in a handful of times a day -- heroes sit idle between visits instead of being re-queued the moment a quest finishes.

label: AFK
description: Checks in roughly once a day. Long real-world gaps between sends, favoring longer-duration quests so less time between check-ins goes to waste idle.
